finding.headline: "The Friendship-Fade"
finding.problem: "We used to talk every day. Now I see their stories and feel like I've become invisible to them. I want my people back but I'm too tired to plan anything."
finding.person: Mum who has lost touch with her three closest friends since birth; feels guilty and doesn't know how to re-connect without a big effort.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone / Marketing angle — "The 5-Minute Friendship: Staying Close When Life Got Loud."". Verdict: PASSES.
